method.bootstrap: question-level (cluster) percentile bootstrap, 10000 reps, seed 20260930 (random.Random("20260930:<set>")), same resamples for every statistic on a set; pooled ratios resample questions, not answers
method.mcnemar: exact two-sided binomial McNemar on discordant pairs
method.holm: Holm–Bonferroni step-down within each 4-test family {L2, L3, W2, WB} (vs A; separately vs P)
method.ess: ess_icc = answers / (1 + (n0 - 1) * ICC) with one-way ANOVA ICC (clipped to [0,1]); ess_bootstrap = p(1-p) / SE_boot^2; ess_lower_bound_rho1 = (sum m_q)^2 / sum m_q^2
method.rule_of_three: 3 / n with n = distinct questions that received a trusted answer (not answers)
method.lenient: strict OR (same row count AND gold has >= 1 measure column AND every gold measure column matches an answer column row by row)
method.lenient_rounding: lenient OR (same row count AND answer measure values equal the gold measure values rounded to d decimals, d in 0..4, one d per answer; only non-integer gold values are rounded; half-up (exact binary), decimal half-up or half-even all accepted)
method.row_source: DQL: rows the answer showed, from a copy of the run store(s); P and A: recorded SQL re-run on a copy of the warehouse (read_only)
method.LB_WB_build: LB and WB count only when identity.dql.commit starts with 627009a1
method.sealed: aggregates only; no question ids, text or SQL are written

excluded.why: no report.json (in progress or never finished)
